result.instructions: Tools for Cliniko, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cliniko data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run cliniko_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cliniko_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cliniko_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. cliniko_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cliniko_get_account
tools.title: Get account details
tools.description: Get the Cliniko account and subscription details for the authenticated API key. A good first call to sanity-check auth, shard, and User-Agent. GET /account.

tools.name: cliniko_list_patients
tools.title: List patients
tools.description: Search/list patients. Name/email filters use Cliniko 'contains' matching (q[]=field:~value). GET /patients.

sort.description: Field to sort by, e.g. created_at.

tools.name: cliniko_get_patient
tools.title: Get a patient
tools.description: Fetch a single patient by id. GET /patients/{id}.

tools.name: cliniko_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List individual appointments, optionally filtered by patient/practitioner/business/type and a starts_at date-time window (starts_from / starts_to, ISO 8601). GET /individual_appointments.

starts_from.description: Only appointments starting at/after this ISO 8601 time (q[]=starts_at:>).

starts_to.description: Only appointments starting before this ISO 8601 time (q[]=starts_at:<).

sort.description: Field to sort by, e.g. created_at.

tools.name: cliniko_get_appointment
tools.title: Get an appointment
tools.description: Fetch a single individual appointment by id. GET /individual_appointments/{id}.

tools.name: cliniko_list_practitioners
tools.title: List practitioners
tools.description: List practitioners in the account. GET /practitioners.

tools.name: cliniko_list_businesses
tools.title: List businesses
tools.description: List businesses (practice locations) in the account. GET /businesses.

tools.name: cliniko_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices, optionally filtered by patient. GET /invoices.

sort.description: Field to sort by, e.g. created_at.

tools.name: cliniko_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Fetch a single invoice by id. GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: cliniko_list_treatment_notes
tools.title: List treatment notes
tools.description: List treatment notes, optionally filtered by patient. NOTE: treatment notes are protected health information (PHI) — handle with care. Read-only. GET /treatment_notes.

tools.name: cliniko_get_treatment_note
tools.title: Get a treatment note
tools.description: Fetch a single treatment note by id. NOTE: treatment notes are protected health information (PHI). Read-only. GET /treatment_notes/{id}.

tools.name: cliniko_list_available_times
tools.title: List available times
tools.description: List bookable appointment slots for a business + practitioner + appointment type within a date range (from/to, yyyy-mm-dd, span <= 7 days). High-value booking-slot lookup. GET /businesses/{business_id}/practitioners/{practitioner_id}/appointment_types/{appointment_type_id}/available_times.

from.description: Range start yyyy-mm-dd (cannot be more than 7 days before `to`).

to.description: Range end yyyy-mm-dd (cannot be more than 7 days after `from`).

tools.name: cliniko_next_available_time
tools.title: Next available time
tools.description: Get the single next bookable slot for a business + practitioner + appointment type (optionally from a date). GET /businesses/{business_id}/practitioners/{practitioner_id}/appointment_types/{appointment_type_id}/next_available_time.

from.description: Optional earliest date yyyy-mm-dd to search from.

tools.name: cliniko_create_patient
tools.title: Create a patient
tools.description: WRITE — creates a REAL new patient record in the live Cliniko practice. Requires first_name + last_name. POST /patients.

phone_number.description: A phone number (stored as a Mobile phone number).

tools.name: cliniko_create_appointment
tools.title: Create an appointment
tools.description: WRITE — books a REAL new individual appointment in the live Cliniko practice. Requires patient_id, practitioner_id, business_id, appointment_type_id, and starts_at (ISO 8601). ends_at defaults from the appointment type if omitted. POST /individual_appointments.

ends_at.description: End time, ISO 8601. Defaults from the appointment type if omitted.
